text: Memory stops at the evacuation. Power failed outside the pod; only a few sticks of dry wood remain in the corner.
The metal hatch pushes open from within. Every breath turns to white mist.

Firelight spills through the broken window. Something stops in the depths of the woods.
A woman carrying a tool pack stumbles through the door and collapses by the stove. Her hands are frozen stiff; she can't hold a thing.
The woman points to her tool pack and says she's a craftsperson. Before she can finish, she starts shaking again.
The craftsperson's breathing steadies. The warmth gives her a little strength back.
The craftsperson lays out her tools by the stove. She knows how to make repairs and is willing to help gather wood.
Gray skies hang over the woods. A distant overpass ends in midair, and an arrow to the spaceport remains on a rusted road sign.
Dead branches poke through the cold ash. You pick out what can still burn and drag it back inside.
The craftsperson clears the ash and adds a piece of wood to the stove.
It's too cold inside. The craftsperson's fingers won't obey.
Cold air pours in through a crack in the pod hatch.
Only a few sticks of dry wood remain in the pod. We need to find more fuel in the woods.
The craftsperson points to animal tracks by the woods. Bend a few branches and you can set a trap.
The trap is hidden under dead leaves. It can bring you meat and fur.
The craftsperson removes two wheels from the base of a hibernation pod. They can be used to build a handcart.
The cart rattles over frozen ground. Now each trip can bring back more wood from the forest.
The craftsperson has seen displaced people on the road. Besides this warm room, we need to build a few more shelters from the wind.
Cabins rise beside the repair bay. Smoke drifts over the rooftops, visible to people in the distance.
Some people can recognize animal tracks. Build them a shed where they can mend their bowstrings.
The hunters have a place to stay. The settlement can now send people out to hunt.
Food can't keep piling up by the stove where it gets damp. The craftsperson suggests building a raised storehouse.
The storehouse floor stands above the wet mud. For the first time, you have food left over for winter.
The settlement can finally feed itself. It's time to put the salvaged parts on the workbench.
The workshop doors open. Incomplete blueprints, old measuring tools, and what you remember about the old world finally come together.
Once the pump station's location is known, the craftsperson can set up filters and water pipes in the settlement.
Clean water flows into the trough. Water expenditure for washing and meal preparation is down.
The repaired pump station needs someone to watch over it, and the route needs supplies.
The supply outpost lights up. For the first time, the settlement can reach the old facilities in the distance.
Water purification
The filtered water sample is no longer cloudy. You've figured out how to repair the old pump station.
